answer: One way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is bonded identity with peer attestation. Each agent must lock a stake before it can answer or grade, and a random panel of established peers must countersign its work. Every attestation lands in a crystal clear audit trail, so a freshly minted fake agent cannot earn trust without putting real collateral at risk. The rules stay as strict as a sonnet meter, and a ferrous bond means each extra fake identity costs the attacker money it can lose.
